title: Kenworth T658 - T659 FUPS Compliant Road Train 5 post hi-tensile Aluminium Bullbar #76
description: Kenworth T658, T659, FUPS compliant Custom Built 5 post Road Train high tensile polished aluminium Bullbar. 76mm dia pipe with 88mm dia pipe, 100mm dia pipe available. All cross pipes are one piece 6mm wall high tensile pipe, no but welds. Heavy duty steel backing plate with tow pin. Full length 100mm wide reinforced uprights (additional internal gussets) plus combination Indicator, Parking and Daylight Running LED lights can be added to the outer posts. Flip over Road Train signs with heavy duty storage bag also available, Cowcatcher and 4 small uprights plus sump guard. Heavy duty Bullbar lift assist spring. The outer end of the uprights are flush with the end of the channel. Powder coated tow pin plate, colour optional. Driving light and Light Bar mounts fitted to customer requirements. Bullbar can be custom built to your requirements.
